name: General-Purpose AI Code of Practice (EU)
summary: Voluntary code published by the European Commission on 10 July 2025 (per the Commission page). Its Transparency and Copyright chapters offer providers of general-purpose AI models a way to demonstrate compliance with Article 53 of the AI Act; the Safety and Security chapter addresses providers of models with systemic risk under Article 55. The Commission page lists 21 organisations as signing the full code and xAI signing only the Safety and Security chapter. Signing the code is voluntary.
key_obligations: Transparency chapter: supports demonstrating Article 53 compliance
Copyright chapter: supports demonstrating Article 53 compliance
Safety and Security chapter: for providers of systemic-risk models (Article 55)
